text:
Marina (Product): quick sync  we want to pilot 'BatchSmart' (adaptive batching + auto-fallback to cheaper model variants) for latency-sensitive tenants. Need cross-team launch criteria and gating by EOW.

Devon (Eng Runtime): ok. runtime work: per-tenant batching policy, cache isolation, and safe fallback path. recommend starting with 3 tenants to limit blast radius.

Marina (Product): agreed. pilot scope = 3 tenants, interactive SLA target = p95 <= 180ms. if exceeded we rollback to no-batch route.

Keith (Eng Infra): infra questions: prewarm / burst slots + routing rules. also need to know KV cache size per tenant for capacity planning. @Devon?

Devon (Eng Runtime): rough numbers: ~2GB KV per warm tenant, plus 1GB overhead. can host canary on a small dedicated pool.

Sana (ML): we can produce two variants: quantized-small and full. will run prompt-level quality checks (200 prompts) to surface regressions before rollout.

Liz (Security): caching PII risk: ensure tenant-scoped cache TTLs and tenant-specific KMS keys. @Keith can infra provide tenant KMS separation for pilot?

Keith (Eng Infra): yes, we can provision tenant-scoped KMS keys in the pilot account. will add to manifest and share PR.

Aaron (SRE): propose alerts/playbook: p95_latency > 220ms for 5m -> page; error_rate > 1% for 1m -> page. need rollback runbook steps documented.

Marina (Product): rollback playbook: flip route to 'no-batch', promote model-small globally for affected tenant, monitor for 30m, then consider re-enable.

Taylor (Solutions): customer facing: make this opt-in via account flag. will prep comms template + opt-in flow. need feature flag to force no-batch per tenant.

Devon (Eng Runtime): sample rollout config below:
```yaml
rollout:
  canary_percent: 5
  canary_tenants: [tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-c]
  metrics:
    - p95_latency
    - tail_latency
    - error_rate
  fallback_model: model-small-quant
  cache_policy: tenant-isolated
```

Marina (Product): deliverables (owners): 1) infra KMS + burst pool (Keith), 2) runtime batching + FF (Devon), 3) model validation set (Sana), 4) security config & light review (Liz), 5) SRE playbook & alerts (Aaron), 6) comms + opt-in (Taylor).

Keith (Eng Infra): timeline: infra tasks done by Tue EOD; canary pool Wed AM. will surface cost impact in breakout doc.

Devon (Eng Runtime): branch with runtime changes by Mon; need infra approval for kernel/alloc config.

Sana (ML): validation results by Wed noon; will also provide eval schema.

Liz (Security): light risk review Mon-Tue, will escalate if any hard blocker.

Aaron (SRE): drafting runbook now; request dry-run on Fri with @Devon and @Keith.

Taylor (Solutions): comms + opt-in docs ETA Wed.

infra-bot: deploy-check: canary pool creation scheduled for 2026-03-25T09:00:00Z.

Marina (Product): small additional gate: for GA beyond pilot we require p95 within 10% of baseline AND model quality regression <= 2% on eval set. agree?

Devon (Eng Runtime): runtime aligned.

Sana (ML): aligned but need eval set schema; I'll post follow-up.

Liz (Security): aligned on security gating.

Keith (Eng Infra): aligned but note capacity cost to product team; will share numbers in escrow breakout.

Aaron (SRE): also request canary minimum duration 48h for stability signals.

Marina (Product): perfect. I'll compile a short checklist and post it. thanks all :rocket:

Devon (Eng Runtime): ping me when infra pool is up and I'll start the canary run.

Marina (Product): leaving thread open; DM me for blockers.
